name: copy-button
title: Copy button
description: Copies a value and confirms in place: the icon becomes a check and the label says Copied; a refused copy says so instead of pretending.
whenToUse: Copying a key, an id, a URL or a code snippet with visible confirmation.
notFor: Copying whole documents or files (offer a download).

spec.motion: Icon feedback uses --pui-duration-feedback (existing 160ms default); reduced/none swaps instantly. Copy result timeout is reading time and does not scale with animation speed.

scopeDefaults.precedence: Instance prop, then nearest UIRoot.defaults entry, then existing component fallback. Only presentation keys are accepted; values, callbacks and operational state remain caller-owned.

spec.appearance: className/style target the visual root; typed classNames reach internal parts. Native refs preserve focus, measurement and existing state. Actual-host motion policy and timings are resolved without recreating state. Managed reduced/none and OS reduction stop decorative loops/displacement; continuous effects pause offscreen or in a hidden document.
